name: Hanameel
bio: Hanameel, Jeremiah's cousin, came to him in the prison court during the Babylonian siege and asked him to exercise his right of redemption by buying his field at Anathoth. Jeremiah bought it for seventeen shekels of silver before witnesses, sealing the deed as a sign that houses, fields, and vineyards would again be bought in the land after the exile (Jeremiah 32:6-15).
